howto_cards.title: The Bombardment
howto_cards.goal: Sink the fleet and keep the fort flag flying.
howto_cards.touch: Tap anywhere to aim and fire the cannon.
howto_cards.keys: Mouse to aim, click or Space to fire.
howto_cards.tip: Shoot incoming shots out of the sky to save the flag.

howto_cards.title: Bobby's Derby
howto_cards.goal: Hit 10 homers before you make 10 outs.
howto_cards.touch: Tap to swing the cane when the pitch arrives.
howto_cards.keys: Space or A to swing; arrows aim on desktop.
howto_cards.tip: Watch his windup. Each pitch has its own tell.

howto_cards.title: Big Jimmy's Tank
howto_cards.goal: Dodge the claws and strike his soft belly.
howto_cards.touch: Drag to swim, tap the glowing button to strike.
howto_cards.keys: WASD to swim, J to strike, Shift to dash.
howto_cards.tip: Bubble vents refill air. Never stray far from one.

howto_cards.title: Chip Kid Duel
howto_cards.goal: Win 3 rounds against her snack-bag mech.
howto_cards.touch: Swipe left or right to dodge, down to duck.
howto_cards.keys: A/D dodge, S duck, J and K to punch.
howto_cards.tip: Counter right after a slam, while the mech recovers.

howto_cards.title: Arabber Al Chase
howto_cards.goal: Catch Al's cart and ram it 3 times in time.
howto_cards.touch: Tilt the stick to steer, tap BOOST to surge.
howto_cards.keys: WASD to steer, Shift to boost.
howto_cards.tip: Thrown produce slows you. Weave, do not brake.

howto_cards.title: Duchess Ram Race
howto_cards.goal: Ram her dragon boat into piers and buoys.
howto_cards.touch: Drag to steer the boat, tap RAM to lunge.
howto_cards.keys: WASD to steer, Space to ram.
howto_cards.tip: Duck behind a buoy when she swings the paddle.

howto_cards.title: Voltage Vic Jam
howto_cards.goal: Hit the notes on the beat to beat Vic.
howto_cards.touch: Tap the 3 zones as notes reach the line.
howto_cards.keys: D, F, J, K for the four note lanes.
howto_cards.tip: Drops land on the beat. Listen and stay calm.

howto_cards.title: Pete's Eat-Off
howto_cards.goal: Clear all your courses before Pete does.
howto_cards.touch: Tap fast to eat, tap the cup to cool down.
howto_cards.keys: Space to eat, L to sip, X to swat food back.
howto_cards.tip: Hit hiccup prompts fast or you lose a bite.

howto_cards.title: Pigeon Tower Climb
howto_cards.goal: Wreck all 5 tower faces, then floor the bird.
howto_cards.touch: Drag to climb, tap a window to smash it.
howto_cards.keys: WASD to climb, J to smash, K to grab.
howto_cards.tip: A shadow on the wall warns where droppings land.

howto_cards.title: Harbor Grand Prix
howto_cards.goal: Finish first around the harbor street loop.
howto_cards.touch: Hold the left side to steer, right side to gas.
howto_cards.keys: Arrows to steer, Space to brake, Shift turbo.
howto_cards.tip: Brake before the hairpin, not inside it.

howto_cards.title: Harbor Fishing
howto_cards.goal: Hook fish and junk, and feed Chompy the junk.
howto_cards.touch: Tap to cast, hold to reel when the line jerks.
howto_cards.keys: Space to cast, hold Space to reel in.
howto_cards.tip: Night brings different catches. Try both.

Tap the right side to punch.
The big glowing button changes by spot.
Hold the punch button for a heavy hit.
Swipe up to jump over gaps.
Tap the map pin to pick a place.
Tap the radio bar for the next station.
Pause any time with the top-left button.

Turn sideways for a wider view.
